detailed_description:
EA SPORTS FC™ 26 TOTY Edition



EA SPORTS FC™ 26 TOTY Edition includes‡:

  • 5,000 Season Points
  • Gold Team of the Year Nominees Starting XI Pack with 11 TOTY Nominee Gold Player Items (Men’s & Women’s) rated 82 or higher

Three (3) 2025 Highlights 1 of 5 Player Item Picks (all untradeable, rated up to 88 OVR, from last year’s EA SPORTS FC 26 Football Ultimate Team campaigns§):
  • Star Defender Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Defenders
  • Star Midfielder Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Midfielders
  • Star Attacker Player Item Pick: Choose 1 of 5 Attackers

§ Includes FC 26 FUT campaigns up to and inclusive of Winter Wildcards.


EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Ultimate Edition

EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Ultimate Edition includes‡:

  • 6000 FC Points over 2 months††
  • 1 additional Ultimate Team™ Player Evolution Slot

Clubs rewards:
  • 1 Archetype Unlock Consumable
  • 2 Double AXP for 10 Matches Consumables

Career rewards:
  • 3 ICON Career Players
  • 5-Star Coach available for hire in Manager Career
  • 5-Star Youth Scout available for hire in Manager Career
  • Manager Live Challenge Content


About the Game



This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items.

legal_notice:
Internet connection; EA Account; Steam Account; acceptance of the EA User Agreement (terms.ea.com); and download & installation of EA's client software EA app (ea.com/ea-app) required to play. EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy applies to your use of EA's services. You consent to any personal data collected through your use of EA's services being transferred to the United States, as further explained in the Privacy & Cookie Policy. You must link your EA and Steam Accounts to play; EA will share your Account ID and individual game and play records with Steam to validate your purchase and/or refund request. Access to software content is limited to one EA & one Steam Account & is non-transferable after purchase. You may need to be 13+ or 16+ to register for an EA Account (age may vary, see o.ea.com/ea/child-access for details) & Ultimate/TOTY Edition content. Some content may require gameplay to unlock. Mandatory updates may be downloaded automatically, incur broadband fees & require additional storage or purchase to access. EA may provide certain free incremental content &/or updates. EA may retire online features after 30 days notice posted on ea.com/service-updates.

EA User Agreement: terms.ea.com/de for German residents and terms.ea.com for all other residents
EA Privacy & Cookie Policy: privacy.ea.com/de for German residents and privacy.ea.com for all other residents

You must redeem your single-use code (if a code is required), log into Ultimate Team, log into Clubs, and create a Career Mode save while connected to EA servers (together these steps are referred to as "redeem") to access your Ultimate Edition Content (6,000 FC Points, one (1) Player Evolution slot, one (1) Archetype Unlock Consumable, two (2) double AXP for 10 matches consumables, three (3) ICONs for Career, one (1) 5-star Coach available for hire in Manager Career, one (1) 5-star Youth Scout for hire in Manager Career and Manager Live challenge content). You must be connected to EA servers when creating a new Career Mode save to use the three (3) ICONs for Career, one (1) 5-star Coach available for hire in Manager Career, one (1) 5-star Youth Scout for hire in Manager Career and Manager Live challenge content. FC Points will be distributed in 3 equal increments. The initial distribution will be granted with your initial login into Ultimate Team in the Product, the second distribution will be granted by the end of the subsequent month, and the 3rd distribution will be granted by the end of the following month. You must complete the steps to obtain the initial FC Points distribution by June 15, 2026 to receive all 6,000 FC Points. If you redeem after September 15, 2026, you will not receive any FC Points.

‡Conditions & restrictions apply. See ea.com/games/ea-sports-fc/fc-26/game-disclaimers for details.

Text and audio commentary for languages other than English and the selected Steam client language requires a separate download.

Ultimate Edition, TOTY Edition & FC Points purchase are not available in Belgium and South Korea.
